title: Limatus
description:
Standalone editorial quality tool: diagnose slop-like weakness, propose constrained rewrite options (markup / redline-style suggestions), human-steered apply with diffs. Quality-first — **not** detector-score evasion.

## Intent

Spin the automated editorial loop out of Papyrus into **Limatus**, a clean isolated package (CLI + Python SDK) with its own local style-rules config. Planning and early milestones live on the Papyrus board until the Limatus repo/package is cut.

## Guardrail

Quality outcomes, not detector-score gaming. North-star: human acceptance after factual review.

## What already exists

Epic `PPY-54055d` — interactive editorial rewrite loop (diagnose → options → steer/apply/provenance), currently in-tree under `papyrus_content`. Style profile + diagnostic JSON closed; rewrite options / verifier / steer-apply remain open.

## Milestones

1. **In-Papyrus MVP loop** (`PPY-54055d`) — finish interactive loop while still in-tree.
2. **Decouple into Limatus** (`PPY-639fb3`) — portable CLI + Python SDK; local style-rules config; no Papyrus imports.
3. **Evaluations** (`PPY-89827a`) — harness for diagnose + rewrite-option quality.
4. **Papyrus consumes Limatus via SDK** (`PPY-b536c2`) — newsroom / Tactus procedures call Limatus; in-tree core removed or shimmed.

## Non-goals

- Detector-gaming "humanizer" products.
- Auto-publishing externally attributable copy without a human gate.

Migrated from PPY-809091.

comments.text:
Session recap (2026-09-09/10), shipped and released, not previously tracked
as individual issues -- recording here for continuity:

- check_rules / check_standfirst / component-source contrast-cap exemption:
  migrated Chattic.us-web's bespoke check_editorial_rules.py (the tool that
  originally inspired Limatus) onto real Limatus, behavior-preserving,
  verified against all existing content before/after.
- rules.noEmojis, rules.bySurface (per-surface contrast-cap override),
  standfirst schema + limatus standfirst / check_standfirst: new profile
  capabilities, all shipped.
- overusedWords check: crutch-word frequency (actually/really/very/...)
  scaled to document length -- caught 7x 'actually' in one Anth.us post.
- uncontractedForms check: flags stated-but-unenforced 'use contractions'
  rules (that is -> that's, does not -> doesn't); per-profile toggle since
  Pilobolus's narrator deliberately stays uncontracted (VOICE.md) --
  confirmed OFF is correct against all 5 of its published pieces.
- editorial_verifier.py frontmatter-masking bug fix: verify() was treating
  a changed title/date as a 'deleted claim', found dogfooding a real
  copy-edit.
- Coverage-audit methodology: read a publication's VOICE.md end to end
  against its style-profile.yml line by line, looking for rules stated in
  prose with no matching mechanical check. Found real gaps this way twice
  (Pilobolus: noEmojis never set, brand-self-naming bans incomplete, 5
  missing jargon words, trailing-Sources-list pattern missing -- one of
  which had already shipped a real violation to a published article
  before the audit caught it). Worth doing for Anth.us and Chattic.us too;
  not yet done.
- Style-profile.yml coverage in production: Anth.us, Pilobolus, and
  Chattic.us profiles all now materially richer than at session start.

All released to PyPI incrementally (0.1.0 -> 0.6.0+) as each check landed,
each with a real dogfooded catch as the reason it was built rather than
speculative coverage.
